{{Top|leg|title=j'ber B'Yen}}
'''J'ber B'Yen''' was a [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] [[j'ber]] on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. The j'ber was formerly numerous, but by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the last survivor was [[B'Yen Do V'nel]], the leader of [[K'Len J'Bar Kasoon]].
